facts.fact: The communications minister installed an ad hoc committee on 13 October 2025 to draft a universal-access strategy and action plan to bring services to rural localities without connectivity, and the World Bank-financed PVI project (USD 100 million, 2020-2026) aims to connect 1.9 million rural people with 3G/4G coverage of 2,175 localities, slowed in 2024.
